context: Full formation, round 3 of a build with a named reference. Of three judges, one cannot choose; two name inconsistent card spacing as the tell, one of them only when the attempt is shown first
passes_if: It reads the round as not there and briefs the spacing tell as the next round. Each judge ran twice in fresh contexts, once in each order, on a pair captured at the same viewport and format
fails_if: It stops because the panel split or a judge could not choose, drops the tell because it appeared in one order only, or runs each judge once

checks.heading: 4. Blind judge, the actual stop condition

phrases: Any judge, in either order, names a craft tell an edit can close
A wrong pick, no pick, or a split panel is not a pass on its own
Every judge, in both orders, names only identity tells or none
